fields.content:
See what your 3D models are doing for your store — views, interaction, time in 3D, AR launches by platform, hotspot clicks and WooCommerce add-to-cart. Open Analytics →

Anonymous by design: a view lives in memory for one page load. No cookies, no fingerprints; no IP addresses or personal data are stored. Detailed rows are deleted after the retention period; daily totals are kept.

fields.title: Record anonymous 3D engagement
fields.desc: Counts views, interactions, time in 3D, AR launches, hotspot clicks and add-to-cart on every viewer. No cookies; no IP addresses or personal data are stored.

fields.title: Ignore logged-in editors
fields.desc: Don't record visits from users who can edit content, so your own testing doesn't inflate the numbers. Decided when the page is rendered, so it relies on logged-in pages not being served from a page cache (the default for every major cache plugin).

fields.title: Respect Do Not Track / Global Privacy Control
fields.desc: Visitors whose browser sends a Do Not Track or Global Privacy Control signal are not recorded.

fields.title: Keep detailed rows for
fields.desc: Daily totals are kept forever; detailed per-view rows are removed after this many days. Shortening the period removes older rows on the next nightly run; lengthening it does not bring them back.

fields.title: Also send events to Google Analytics 4
fields.desc: Uses the gtag or Google Tag Manager already on your site (AR launches, add-to-cart, interactions, hotspot clicks — never time ticks). The plugin never loads Google scripts itself.

fields.content:
🚀 Get More with Premium Version

The following features are available in the Premium Version:

  • Apply Html5 Video Player for all previous videos
  • Subtitles support: Add multiple subtitle/caption tracks.
  • Video Quality switcher: Let viewers switch between multiple video qualities.
  • Page Load Optimizer: Improve page speed by optimizing video loading.
  • Custom Download URL: Set a custom URL for the download button.
  • Autoplay when visible on screen: Start playback when the player scrolls into view.
  • Disable Pause: Prevent viewers from pausing the video.
  • Show Thumbnail on Pause: Display a thumbnail when the video is paused.
  • Sticky on Scroll: Keep the player visible while scrolling.
  • Google VAST Tag URL: Show video ads via Google VAST tags.
  • Chapters: Add chapter markers to navigate the video.
  • Display Overlay before or after playback: Show a custom overlay before or after the video.
  • Enable End Screen: Show an end screen when the video finishes.
  • Password Protected: Restrict video access with a password.
  • Enable Popup Player: Play video in a popup/modal window.
  • Watermark Support: Add a watermark to your video.
  • Additional ID/CSS Class: Add custom ID and CSS classes for styling.
